entities.name: Eldrich Aldercrest
entities.description: An ancient individual who lived for centuries, survivor of historical conflicts, who is finally freed from his burdens upon his death.
entities.quote: For the first time in centuries... Eldrich Aldercrest was free.

entities.name: Elina
entities.description: A woman loved by Eldrich, associated with Damian who is described as a version of Eldrich that succeeded in love.
entities.quote: Then he turned toward Elina's grave. The woman he had loved. The woman he watched grow old.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: An ancient, dark, and familiar figure who confronts Eldrich and claims his bloodline ends with him.
entities.quote: And then another presence entered the graveyard. Ancient. Dark. Familiar. Khalid.
